decisions.reason: After the 2024 pruning of other express offers, the seventy-two-hour program appears to be the surviving fast-delivery option, so we keep it, though its high ongoing operational burden still leaves a meaningful chance of withdrawal if demand or margin disappoints.

This certified fire-resistant exterior door sits squarely in our core safety-focused portfolio and, built on an existing modular system, has strong strategic fit and low reason to abandon after another year.
The digital ordering and service platform has high option value for learning, customer integration, and service expansion, while the cost of keeping it available is relatively modest.

The fire and smoke protection door remains closely aligned with our compliance and safety strengths, so it is worth retaining while sales evidence continues to accumulate, despite some portfolio complexity risk.
